It is outside the Product lane's allowed edit scope (product may not edit codex/) and does not affect the measured shipping-path bytes.

REPRESENTATION CAVEAT (non-blocking): mechanism_id is 'mech-' + sha256({intent, template, slots}) where template embeds the executed action URL. Because the fixture binds an ephemeral port, mechanism_id and the bound_action URL are not stable across independent runs even though the support/slots/confidence and all clause statuses are. Downstream work should reference the mechanism by its induced support/slots/confidence, not by a cross-run mechanism_id.

SCOPE: this is readiness condition (1) only. It does not run the four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark (readiness (2)+(3) unmet), does not re-run the promotion certificate or the mandatory-discovery REST certificate, does not compare COLD/INSTRUCTIONS/RETRIEVAL arms, and makes no economics or wall-clock claim (model_calls=model_tokens=0, latency_ms=0).

REPRESENTATION LOSS: the substrate is a minimal deterministic GET/JSON loopback fixture over a single resource shape; correctness/refusal is established only for the induced single-digit-suffix support grammar, not for free-form payload values.

INFRASTRUCTURE-VS-NEGATIVE: no infrastructure failure occurred; status=COMPLETE with outcome=SUPPORTS reflects a valid measurement transaction under the frozen decision rule, not a claim advance. C-PARAM-INHERIT stays EXPERIMENTAL.
unresolved: Whether the conservative support inference (single-digit suffix learned from 5 examples) is a defect for free-form payload values remains untested; this packet probes only the in-support unseen boundary (item-000) and the out-of-support boundary (item-010).
